$description: Sumuk (수묵) — INZEUM design tokens, W3C DTCG 2025.10 format. The single source of truth for apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.generated.ts (built by scripts/build-tokens.mjs). Dark-first 먹과 한지: midnight ink surfaces, 한지 paper text, one vermilion seal. Colors are sRGB; opaque colors use the #RRGGBB shorthand, translucent ones the full color object. Dimensions are px, which React Native reads as density-independent points.

palette.$description: Raw ramps — never used directly in screens; compose the `color` roles instead.

600.$description: Highest — chips on cards, strokes on elevated.

paper.$description: 한지 Paper ramp — text and light surfaces.

100.$description: 한지빛 ★ display / Latin text on dark.

600.$description: 분청 — faint text / hints; 4.68:1 on ink900.

vermilion.$description: 낙관 Vermilion ramp — THE accent. At most two red points per screen.

celadon.$description: 청자 Celadon — secondary / data. Never competes with vermilion.

color.$description: Semantic roles — what screens actually use. This is the dark (default) mapping; `theme.hanji` remaps the same role names for light.

chipBg.$description: Chips on cards, strokes on elevated.

fill1.$description: Control fill, lightest. Opaque: a paper tint at 6% took its colour from whatever artwork sat under it, so the same chip read differently on every cover.

fill2.$description: Control fill, medium — pressed icon circles, inert primary buttons.

fill3.$description: Control fill, strongest — quiet multi-select chips, practiced-day circles.

line.$description: Hairline — elevation on dark is a surface step + a line, not a shadow.

lineSoft.$description: Softer hairline — list-row separators, tile strokes.

scrim.$description: Modal backdrop / badge scrim — warm ink, never pure black.

scrimSoft.$description: Light veil over full-bleed artwork: mutes the art for text without hiding it.

textDisplay.$description: Serif headlines, Latin wordmark, big numbers.

textMuted.$description: Muted text — eyebrows, captions, stat labels.

textFaint.$description: Faint text / hints — the floor of readable contrast (4.68:1).

accent.$description: Primary action — a neutral, not the seal (ADR 0037). Buttons, active state, selected.

brand.$description: The seal — 화면당 낙관 1~2점. Spent deliberately, never a default action colour.

accentSoft.$description: Primary at 12% — selected row, quiet active background.

onBrand.$description: Glyph on a brand fill. Ink, not paper: paper on vermilion measures 3.13:1 and fails AA.

positive.$description: "잘 잤어요" moments — not the green-success cliché.

celadonText.$description: Celadon text on dark — secondary data labels.

danger.$description: Destructive — its own role (ADR 0037), and light enough to be read: it is body text in ~20 error messages, 5.25:1 on bg. A darker red fails AA on a dark ground.

dangerFill.$description: Destructive as a SURFACE (SwipeToDelete). One value cannot be both readable on ink and readable under a paper label — the text role and the fill role are a pair, exactly as brand / onBrand are.

onDanger.$description: Label on a destructive fill — 6.60:1 on dangerFill.

paperBg.$description: Light reading surface (책 / 스크립트 뷰) — the 한지 flip.

paperLine.$description: Hairline on a light reading surface.

inkOnPaper.$description: Text on a light reading surface.

theme.$description: Alternate role maps. A theme is a remap of the same role names onto the same palette (the Material 3 idea) — never a second palette. `hanji` is the light mode: generated as `themes.hanji`, NOT wired into screens yet; it exists so light mode is a mapping decision, not a rewrite.

hanji.$description: 한지 light mode. Same role names as `color`. Note: the paper ramp has no AA mid-tone on paper50, so textMuted / textFaint here are hint-only (≈3.3–3.9:1) — a light ship needs one more paper step first.

bgDeep.$description: Player / immersive: one step warmer than bg.

scrim.$description: Modal backdrop — warm ink, lighter than on dark.

textDisplay.$description: Serif headlines, wordmark, big numbers on paper.

accent.$description: Primary action on paper — a neutral (ADR 0037).

brand.$description: The seal on paper — the darker step for contrast.

accentOnDark.$description: Soft accent — same as accent on paper.

positive.$description: Positive data on paper — the darker celadon.

danger.$description: Destructive is its own role (ADR 0037). On paper the dark step is the readable one — the dark/light inversion of the same rule.

onDanger.$description: Label on a destructive fill on paper.

paperBg.$description: Reading surface — identical to bg in this theme.

space.$description: Spacing scale — the only allowed values. Gutter 24 · card 16/24 · section 32.

radius.$description: Corners (brand: 부드러운 모서리). Pick per component, never ad-hoc.

md.$description: Buttons, inputs, cards, sheets — the default.

pill.$description: Round things only — avatars, dots, toggles, progress. NOT buttons (ADR 0037).

text.$description: Type scale (px / line-height) — design-system §2. Each style is a fontSize + lineHeight pair; family and weight are chosen at the call site (serif / weight props on AppText).

numeric.$description: The one numeric display level (KRQ 점수) — tabular figures.

display.$description: Screen hero — the largest reading size. Reached through `variant={compact ? 'h1' : 'display'}`, so a literal-variant grep will not find it.

meta.$description: Eyebrows, timestamps, row subtitles — sans 500. Leading is 1.50, not 1.33: this is the most-used style in the app and it wraps.

fontScaleCap.$description: Max font-scale multiplier per text style. Display and chrome typography cannot grow at the same rate as reading copy: at the largest iOS accessibility presets a 34pt hero becomes 68pt and pushes every control below it out of the viewport. Body / reading text still reaches the WCAG 200% target; headings use a restrained cap and keep their full spoken label through accessibility APIs. Keys must match `text` one for one.

fontFamily.$description: Marcellus = Latin display / wordmark / big numbers. 나눔명조 = Korean serif display (헤드라인, 인용). Pretendard = body / UI, two weights plus semibold for buttons — 600 is the ceiling; there is no bold or black.

semibold.$description: Buttons and emphasised titles — the heaviest sans weight in the system.

serif.$description: Kept as a key so `serif` call sites still compile; there is no serif face any more (ADR 0037).

serifRegular.$description: Kept as a key so `serif` call sites still compile (ADR 0037).

latin.$description: One family: Latin no longer switches face mid-screen (ADR 0037).

motion.$description: Breathing pace, never springs (design-system §4). `settle` = screen enter · `press` = touch feedback · `breath` = idle loops. Under the OS reduce-motion setting, `settle` and `sheet` collapse to `reducedMotion` and breath loops do not run.

settle.$description: Screen enter: fade + rise, cubic-out, staggered down the screen.

press.$description: Touch feedback on buttons and cards.

reducedMotion.$description: What settle / sheet durations become when the OS reduce-motion setting is on (`useReducedMotion`). Breath loops stop rather than shorten.

easing.$description: Named curves. Emitted as CSS `cubic-bezier()` strings; on native, `Easing.bezier(...)` takes the same four numbers.

koreanTracking.$description: Korean: never positive tracking, never uppercase, keep-all word break.

latinDisplayTracking.$description: Marcellus-only Latin display tracking (자간 +0.09em ≈ per 브랜드가이드).

contentMaxWidth.$description: Widest the content column ever gets. `Screen` caps its content here and every docked or centred surface matches it, so a tablet or an unfolded fold gets margins instead of an 840dp line. Anything sizing itself from `useWindowDimensions().width` must clamp to this first (the 3-up grid did not, 2026-08-22).

size.$description: Control sizes. Every tap target is at least `hitTarget`.

buttonHeightSm.$description: Compact button (sheet actions). 44, not 40 — the hit-target minimum has no exceptions (ADR 0037).

zIndex.$description: Stacking order. Higher layers never share a value with lower ones.

dock.$description: Tab bar, mini player, docked footers.

opacity.$description: The only opacities controls may take.

pressed.$description: Pressed state on a text-only or image control.

busy.$description: Control awaiting a result (keeps its accent).

elevation.$description: Elevation on dark = surface step + hairline, never a shadow. Each level names the surface and the stroke.
